title: Route failed current-head critical gates to one durable existing PR owner instead of treating completed red runs as coverage
root_cause: Verified existing five-minute Required Gate Watchdog checks only for absence of a Required run; a completed failed run is considered present, with no owner signal. Prior website mobile CLS 0.168 > 0.100 was detected on #4656 without auto handoff to canonical website owner #4651. The watchdog also filters on PR.updated_at >2h before fetching Actions runs, so new failures on older PRs were invisible.
impact: Failed Required / CodeQL outcomes can persist unnoticed by owner agents; repeated source-test retries or duplicate PRs risk queue pressure and obscured real layout defects.
failed_approaches: Treating any completed Required test as successful coverage
Blind rerun-failed-jobs on no-job CodeQL startup_failure (GitHub HTTP 403)
Creating a parallel workflow/scheduler or new same-file PR
Waiving browser CLS 0.100 gate to force green
fix: Existing Required Gate Watchdog now classifies latest exact-head Required and CodeQL, emits deduplicated structured PR owner recovery notes with immutable failing job refs and no blind retry, while keeping missing-run dispatch unchanged. Follow-up: a bounded 12-way hourly shard inspects older open PRs for exact-head failures without permitting missing-Required redispatch on old PRs.
prevention_rule: A current-head failed critical gate must remain RECOVERY_REQUIRED until the original writer fixes proven source and verifies exact-head Required, CodeQL and deployment. Detect one fail signal per immutable gate/head in the existing five-minute watchdog; never create duplicate recovery writer or scheduler; preserve CLS<=0.100, tenancy, security and all real gates. Decouple failed-gate observation from missing-run dispatch age: every older open PR gets one exact-head status observation per 12 five-minute ticks. Preserve per-head dedup and two signals per tick.
outcome: CANDIDATE follow-up aged-PR blindspot fix; exact-head CI, CodeQL, runtime observation and production readback pending

shadow: Failed Required and CodeQL signal should route to only the original writer once per immutable head
Older open PR with recent failed gate receives canonical handoff in one-hour shard
negative_canary: Queued and in_progress must not be retried
Failed source test must not be marked green or bypassed
Duplicate signal on same head must not create second comment
Sitewide phone CLS 0.168 > 0.100 must remain a failing gate
Old PR without a Required run never causes workflow dispatch storm
